q: The power a cylinder exerts in a meridian oblique to its axis varies with the:
o: cosine of the angle from the axis
tangent of the angle from the axis
ans: sine squared of the angle from the axis
w: A cylinder has no power along its axis and full power 90 degrees away; between, power follows the sine-squared of the angle from the axis. This also underlies obliquely crossed cylinders.
k: Oblique cylinder power follows sine-squared of the angle from the axis.

q: Two prisms acting in perpendicular meridians combine into a resultant equal to the:
ans: vector sum of the two prisms
w: Perpendicular prisms add as vectors, so the resultant magnitude is the square root of the horizontal squared plus the vertical squared, with base direction set by the quadrant.
k: Perpendicular prisms combine as a vector sum.
